type: Current Power Stack analysis — transcript-led discovery with independent verification
evidencePolicy: StockedUp, FXEvolution and TradeBrigade are zero-weight hypothesis generators. Theme significance, research priority and proof requirements move only after independent primary/current verification. Stock-specific fundamental scores do not move from transcript or macro-theme evidence alone.
headlineRead: The regime is best described as an inflationary physical-scarcity buildout colliding with duration and financing constraints. Refined products and LNG are transmitting the Middle East shock beyond crude; the long end resisted Treasury liquidity support; equity breadth and small caps are increasingly rate-sensitive; meanwhile record power demand and copper confirm that AI physical buildout remains real. The investable split is funded, cash-generative scarcity versus financing-dependent duration, not simply risk-on versus risk-off.
keyChanges: Refinery framing tightened: the verified issue is limited spare refining slack plus very high utilization and product cracks, not the creator claim of the lowest capacity ever.
Duration strengthened: up to $6bn of 10-20Y Treasury buybacks was announced while the 10Y still reached roughly 4.85%, making the market response a useful clearing-rate/news-failure signal.
AI financing strengthened sharply: hyperscaler bond supply, euro-market crowding and tighter project underwriting make cash conversion and funding quality a first-class gating variable.
LNG rerouting promoted: Gulf disruption plus lower European storage creates Europe/Asia competition for Atlantic LNG and electricity/industrial inflation risk.
Breadth added as a regime overlay: equal-weight, advance-decline and small-cap weakness amplify rate risk but do not independently constitute a crash call.
Gold strengthened structurally after central-bank and ETF-flow verification; the creator month error on China's 20t purchase was corrected from August to July.
Positive S&P earnings revisions remain the main counterweight to the bearish breadth/rates evidence.

regimeOverlays.read: Broad participation is deteriorating while large-cap indices remain near highs. Use this to raise fragility and rate-sensitivity, especially for small caps and weaker balance sheets, but require price/credit confirmation before escalating to a broad risk-off regime.

Q3 S&P bottom-up EPS estimates rose through July-August rather than following the usual early-quarter decline. Strong revisions and selected mega-cap/semiconductor resilience reduce conviction in a blanket bearish equity thesis.
